name: Highschool in Dasawarsha
source:
"What if Marsha is a highschooler? Spending her youth days in a public school, with her friends... and lover"

A fanmade Visual Novel by MarshaOshi to celebrate 17th birthday of JKT48's Marsha.

[Edited from [url=https://marshaoshi.itch.io/highschool-in-dasawarsha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果玛莎是一名高中生怎么办？在公立学校度过青春岁月，与她的朋友……还有爱人一起”

MarshaOshi为庆祝JKT48玛莎17岁生日而创作的粉丝视觉小说。

[编辑自[url=https://marshaoshi.itch.io/highschool-in-dasawarsha]Itch.io[/url]]
